dispute.claim_text: Cardholder has filed a 'merchandise not received' dispute, claiming the order never arrived.

evidence.text: Order confirmation: office chairs x5, USD 1250.00, ship-to matches the cardholder's billing address.
Status: 'Delivered, signature captured: J. SMITH, 2026-09-05 14:20', delivered to the cardholder's address.
Cardholder support chat: 'Order arrived, thanks' — sent one day after delivery, before the dispute was filed.

labels.notes: Merchant-side case (exercises the advocate parameter). Critical point 13.1-r1 is merchant-supported: signed delivery to the cardholder's address, plus the cardholder's own acknowledgement of receipt before filing. Strong representment; merchant should fight.
